# Story Guide Generator — Full-Stack Guide

## How to Run

### 1. Backend (FastAPI)

```bash
# From project root, activate venv first
.\venv\Scripts\activate

# Start the API server (default: http://localhost:8000)
python run_api.py

# Custom port
python run_api.py --port 8080

# API docs (auto-generated by FastAPI)
# http://localhost:8000/docs
```

### 2. Frontend (React + Vite)

```bash
# Open a second terminal
cd frontend
npm run dev

# → http://localhost:5173
```

> Vite proxies all `/api/*` requests to `http://localhost:8000` automatically — no CORS issues in dev.

---

## API Endpoints

| Method | Path | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `GET` | `/api/health` | Health check |
| `GET` | `/api/dashboards` | List available dashboards |
| `POST` | `/api/runs` | Start a pipeline run |
| `GET` | `/api/runs` | List all runs (most recent first) |
| `GET` | `/api/runs/{id}` | Get run status |
| `GET` | `/api/runs/{id}/logs` | Stream live logs (SSE) |
| `GET` | `/api/runs/{id}/download` | Download output `.docx` |

### POST /api/runs — Request Body

```json
{
  "dashboard": "risk-dash",
  "from_stage": null,
  "force": false,
  "dry_run": false,
  "skip_verifier": false,
  "skip_catalog": false,
  "no_test": false
}
```

### Run Status Values

| Status | Meaning |
|--------|---------|
| `pending` | Created, not started yet |
| `running` | Pipeline subprocess active |
| `completed` | Finished with exit code 0 |
| `failed` | Non-zero exit code |

## Folder Structure

```
Story Guide Generator/
│
├── run_api.py                  ← FastAPI server entry point
│
├── api/                        ← FastAPI backend
│   ├── __init__.py
│   ├── main.py                 ← App + CORS middleware
│   ├── models.py               ← Pydantic request/response models
│   ├── store.py                ← In-memory run state tracker
│   └── routes/
│       ├── __init__.py
│       ├── dashboards.py       ← GET /api/dashboards
│       └── runs.py             ← All /api/runs/* endpoints
│
├── frontend/                   ← React + Vite frontend
│   ├── package.json
│   ├── vite.config.js          ← Dev proxy: /api → localhost:8000
│   ├── tailwind.config.js
│   ├── postcss.config.js
│   ├── index.html
│   └── src/
│       ├── main.jsx
│       ├── App.jsx             ← Router (/ and /runs/:id)
│       ├── index.css           ← Tailwind base styles
│       ├── api/
│       │   └── client.js       ← axios instance (baseURL=/api)
│       ├── pages/
│       │   ├── Home.jsx        ← Dashboard cards + options + run history
│       │   └── RunDetail.jsx   ← Live logs + stage progress + download
│       └── components/
│           ├── LogViewer.jsx   ← Terminal-style auto-scroll log viewer
│           └── StageProgress.jsx ← Stage badges (pending/running/done)
│
├── main.py                     ← Pipeline orchestrator (unchanged)
├── src/                        ← Pipeline source modules (unchanged)
├── input/                      ← .pbip input files (unchanged)
├── output/                     ← Generated outputs (unchanged)
├── prompt/                     ← LLM prompt files (unchanged)
├── requirements.txt            ← Python deps (includes fastapi + uvicorn)
└── .env                        ← Environment variables (unchanged)
```

---

## Notes

- **Run state is in-memory** — restarting the API server clears run history.
- **Live logs** use Server-Sent Events (SSE) via native browser `EventSource`.
- **Download** button appears only when run `status === "completed"` and the `.docx` exists at `output/<dashboard>_story_guide.docx`.
- The frontend Vite dev proxy handles CORS in development. For production, serve the built frontend as static files from FastAPI or a separate web server.
